description_en: Configures a Database Backup (DBS) backup plan
description_zh: 该接口用于配置一个DBS备份计划
name: ConfigureBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The location of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter. Valid values:

RDS
ECS
Express: databases connected over Express Connect circuits, VPN gateways, or Smart Access Gateway (SAG)
Agent: databases connected over backup gateways
DDS: ApsaraDB for MongoDB
Other: databases connected by using IP addresses and port numbers
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。取值如下：

RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
parameters.help_zh:
数据库地域，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database connection address. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is set to express, agent, or other
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpoint.InstanceType is set to express, agent, other, or ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpoint.InstanceType为express、agent、other、ECS时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when the database engine is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the database account.

This parameter is not required when the database engine is Redis, or when the database is connected over a backup gateway (agent) and the database engine is SQL Server. This parameter is required in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为SQL Server时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.

This parameter is not required when the database engine is Redis, or when the database is connected over a backup gateway (agent) and the database engine is SQL Server. This parameter is required in other scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为SQL Server时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup gateway. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter.

This parameter is required when SourceEndpointInstanceType is set to agent
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值。

SourceEndpointInstanceType为agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the OSS bucket.

By default, the system automatically generates a new name
parameters.help_zh:
OSS Bucket名称。

系统默认自动生成新的名称
parameters.name: oss_bucket_name

parameters.example: [     {         "DBName":"待备份库名",         "SchemaName":"待备份 Schema 名",         "TableIncludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份表表名"         }],         "TableExcludes":[{             "TableName":"待备份库名不需要备份表的表名"         }]     } ]
parameters.help_en: The objects to be backed up. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 备份对象，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_objects

parameters.help_en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:
Monday: Monday
Tuesday: Tuesday
Wednesday: Wednesday
Thursday: Thursday
Friday: Friday
Saturday: Saturday
Sunday: Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The start time of the full backup. The time is in the HH:mmZ format and displayed in UTC. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 全量备份开始时间，格式为HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_start_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable incremental log backup. Valid values:
true: enables incremental log backup
false: disables incremental log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启增量日志备份，取值：
true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The interval for incremental backup, in seconds.
This parameter is supported only for physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
仅支持物理备份
parameters.name: backup_log_interval_seconds

parameters.help_en: The retention period of backup data. Valid values: 0 to 1825. Default value: 730. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 备份数据保留时间，取值：0 ~ 1825，默认为730天
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The period after which backup data is transitioned to Infrequent Access (IA) storage. Default value: 180. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 转为低频访问存储时间，默认为180天
parameters.name: duplication_infrequent_access_period

parameters.help_en: The period after which backup data is transitioned to Archive storage. Default value: 365. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 转为归档冷备存储时间，默认为365天
parameters.name: duplication_archive_period

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the backup plan. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 自定义备份计划名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869825.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: backup_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The Oracle system identifier (SID).

This parameter is required when the database engine is Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle SID名称。

数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en:
The built-in storage type. Valid values:
Empty string (default): Backup data is stored in your OSS bucket.
system: Backup data is stored in the built-in OSS bucket of DBS
parameters.help_zh:
内置存储类型：
空（默认）：备份数据存储在用户OSS上。
system ：备份数据存储在DBS的内置OSS上
parameters.name: backup_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk I/O limit. Unit: KB/s.
This parameter takes effect only for MySQL physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘IO限制 ， 单位为KB/s。
仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_speed_limit

parameters.help_en:
The network bandwidth throttling. Unit: KB/s. Maximum value: 10 GB.
This parameter takes effect only for MySQL physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
网络带宽限制， 单位为KB/s ，最大允许10GB。
仅对MySQL物理备份生效
parameters.name: backup_rate_limit

parameters.help_en:
The full backup epoch. Valid values:
simple: periodic backup, which is used together with BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime
manual: manual backup

Default value: simple
parameters.help_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
simple：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
manual：手动备份。

默认为simple
parameters.name: backup_strategy_type

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account for cross-account backup. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: cross_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role for cross-account backup. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2869838.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic backup. Valid values:

true: enables automatic backup
false: disables automatic backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动备份。

true：开启
false：不开启
parameters.name: auto_start_backup

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can use the client to generate the value, and you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable an SSL-encrypted connection to the source database instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启备份源数据库实例SSL安全连接
parameters.name: enable_source_endpoint_ssl

parameters.help_en: The encryption method for backup storage
parameters.help_zh: 备份存储加密方式
parameters.name: backup_storage_encrypt_method

parameters.help_en: The PEM certificate for the SSL-encrypted connection to the source database
parameters.help_zh: 备份源数据库SSL安全连接PEM证书
parameters.name: ssl_ca_pem

parameters.help_en: Oracle Home
parameters.help_zh: Oracle Home
parameters.name: source_endpoint_oracle_home

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable log backup for MySQL physical backup
parameters.help_zh: 开启MySQL物理备份的日志备份
parameters.name: enable_mysql_physical_backup_binlog

BackupPlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup plan

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
